pages.text: Twelve blocks of deck: three cars, or a bus.

It carries the cars, vans, trucks and buses of $(thing)Reiko's Car Mod$() (without that mod it carries nothing).$(br2)$(l)Driving on$(): with the train stopped, drive up to a free end, lined up with it, and keep going. The car rolls aboard to the far end, or up to the cars already there; a train of them fills from the far end.

$(l)Driving off$(): sit in the car with the train stopped and keep going forwards or backwards: off the end of the train that way, or on to the next transporter.$(br2)Aboard, a car stays put: it doesn't drive, burn fuel or wear. It won't take one that doesn't fit. Clicking it says how many cars are aboard.
Cars by rail, on the way to the docks.

$(l)Trailers$(): a pickup or SUV towing a camper or a livestock trailer drives on with it (forwards: no backing a trailer on), if there's room for both. Aboard, the car mod's hitch key ($(k:key.reikocars.hitch)) unhitches the trailer, leaving it on the deck, and hitches it up again.

$(l)Car Ramps$(): put a row of $(item)Car Ramps$() beside the track, rising towards it, for a loading dock. A car on the ramp, lined up with a standing car transporter beside it, drives aboard sideways when you keep driving, to the nearest place with room; and a car aboard beside a ramp drives off onto it.
A pickup and its camper aboard, beside a row of ramps.
